warning: All secret keys and deterministic RNG bytes are test-only and MUST NOT be used in production.
note: The HPKE construction sealing this envelope's payload is unchanged from vectors/crypto-v1.json's hpke vectors; this file exercises the envelope header and inner plaintext framing this profile adds, not HPKE itself.

negative.name: envelope_byte_tamper
negative.operation: For every byte offset in envelope_hex, xor the byte with 0x01 and require rejection (malformed header or authentication failure).

negative.name: wrong_expected_exporter_encryption_key
negative.operation: Open with an encryption public key other than exporter_encryption_ikm_hex's derived public key and require authentication failure.

negative.name: wrong_recipient
negative.operation: Open with an encryption secret key other than the one derived from importer_encryption_ikm_hex and require authentication failure.

negative.name: unsupported_version
negative.operation: Replace byte offset 4 (the version byte, 0x01) with 0xff and require rejection before any decryption attempt.

negative.name: truncated_envelope
negative.operation: Remove the last byte of envelope_hex and require rejection.

negative.name: relay_hint_count_exceeds_bound
negative.operation: A plaintext whose relay-hint-count byte exceeds MAX_RELAY_HINTS (8) MUST be rejected as malformed, independent of whether the declared hints are present.
